## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] A fixed defect has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Docs match the code: capabilities, limitations and compatibility (with evidence labels) where behaviour changed
- [ ] If data handling changed: privacy policy (and its effective date), store listing, and a **Data** entry in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No remote code, no new permission, no secrets or private page content in code, tests or results
